[quote=bundesreich_chesepeake;60274853][b]Chaos in the capital[/b]

[i]In the aftermath of the revolution in Flousechia which led to the end of the monarchy and the collapse of the bi-national state. Nevonia was on its own with the increasingly unpopular monarchy. Flousechia and Nevonia were officially one bi-national state but in reality Flousechia held most of the power and often influenced the local affairs of Nevonia. So as the revolution in Flousechia became more violent and as the Flousechian monarchy was overthrown, the union between the two states came crashing down. With the complete independence of Nevonia King Klaes II had complete control without any checks. As this all occured people were not at all happy. Anti-monarchy protest across the country sprung up. Out of fear of being overthrown the King made a technical concession. The government would have a change in leadership where a Prime Minister would be in charge instead of the King. However there was a technicality because the King would appoint the Prime Minister without any approval or conformation and the King could remove the Prime Minister at any time. As a result the Prime Minister became a pointless position and the people demanded true change.[/i]

[I]Protest throughout the country became bigger and in many cases protesters took over the streets. The protest though were largely peaceful. As protest grew so did the censorship. protesters were arrested and tortured, soldiers were stationed in cities to display fear and any form of media deemed to be anti-monarchy was outlawed. In the capital city of Tarenbur it seemed like there was a new protest 24/7. Outside of government buildings protest encampments were set up even when the encampments were destroyed protesters would keep building new ones. Every corner of the city was filled with protest and soon the police began to open fire. The King in his delusional view thought that he could fix everything so he went out on a balcony to speak to a crowd. As soon as King Klaes II opened his mouth hecklers yelled and interrupted the King before he could even speak, the speech was a disaster and helped nothing. It seemed the situation couldn't get worse but the worst was still to come.[/I]

[b]Beginning of Operation MOCKINGBIRD | ERENE2000 | Second Flouesch Republic[/b]

[b][sub]Report from the Departement fir Staatssécherheet (STASE) Field Office: 'Constantine', Tarenbur [/sub][/b]

[b][sub]Reporting Agent "MOCKINGBIRD" dated 10/27/25[/sub][/b]

[b][sub]For the First Consul, Tribune, and Chief of Staff, and other related officials only. Unauthorized access to this report can result in detainment or arrest.[/sub][/b]

[i]The Stase has made a detailed analysis of the major factors contributing to the upheavals in the Kingdom of Nivonia and our short window of opportunity to intervene ourselves in the conflict for the purposes of ousting their monarchy and replacing it with a controllable "Sister Republic". Below are the summarized major points of this analysis for your quick reviewing purposes, and additionally a summarized version of potential strategies for using the Department for State Security in covert missions to supply republican rebels and inflame tensions between the people and the monarchy.

A. The collapse of our monarchy has indeed had wide-ranging effects on the stability in our former co-national partner. 6 years of violent fighting across Floueschia, followed by 3 months of complete disintegration of royalist forces has degraded locals' loyalty to their king and monarch, and agitation from our revolution has put them on the brink of their own. However, It should be stated that seemingly large sections of the Nivonian military remain loyal to the king. Unlike our revolution, which had the support of lower ranking officers in the army and the entire air force in the beginning. 

B. It's likely that direct military intervention at this time would not deter the Nivonian military from engaging in a long-term, attritional conflict that the National People's Army can, at this time, scarcely afford. The Nivonian Military, while comparatively weaker than ours, is far more organized than the NVA, which after an army purge initiated in September, is lacking key middle-ranking and high-ranking officer positions, and additionally, destruction across our country would slow key logistics that our fuel-hungry military needs. It's also likely that other nations would respond if we launched a military intervention at this time. We still believe the option looking forward is direct military intervention, however.

C. The revolutionaries in Navonia are currently severely disorganized. It would be highly unlikely that if they launched an uprising at this moment that it would be of any success. Additionally, our STASE agents embedding themselves within the revolutionaries have so far found no plans to do so. This is a hamper in our plans as the longer we have to wait for a revolution to begin, the greater risk of international efforts to stabilize the country.

It is therefore the suggestion of the STASE that the Administration begin undertaking the following actions

A. Order the National People's Air Force to begin illegally entering Navonian airspace to begin scouting out major military targets. A quick, effective strike on military assets will make a quick and speedy intervention in the country much easier. Additionally, they should scout out for civilian infrastructure like substations and roads. It is unlikely the Navonians would be willing to provoke a conflict with us even if they notice our aircraft occasionally entering their airspace. Therefore, our pilots should be safe.

B. Allow the STASE to begin taking up leadership positions within the revolutionaries, and also begin instigating conflict with monarchist forces at rallies and protests to turn the revolution more violent. Additionally, propaganda should be spread through Navonian social media networks, encouraging revolutionary activities; this can be mostly done through internet bots or hired actors. The hope is that with the enlargement of opposition, the King, who is famously incompetent and overreactive, will institute harsher measures that will inevitably lead to more violent and bloody confrontation, while this will in the short term, result in collateral casualties. The result will be an inflammation of anger within the Navonian Population that will drastically increase support for revolution

C. Begin moving the National People's Army into position for a quick and deadly offensive operation that could take major cities within 2 weeks of its beginning, with revolutionary support. Additionally, begin building a case for intervention, this could include allowing the Stase to stage, or instigate border incidents and conflicts with either the Navonian Army, or the Royalist Army remnants that retreated into the safety of Navonia's borders after the disintegration of the Royal Army.

D. The STASE is awaiting authorization to begin covert supply missions to anti-monarchist groups with weapons and improvised explosive devices, the IEDs in specific will be used to escalate attacks against monarchist authorities, and also give a pretense and plausible deniability  for the preemptive elimination of important military and civilian infrastructure on the border that could be used by Navonia to interfere with Floueschian Intervention[/i]

[b][sub]End Report[/sub][/b]
